content:
Thrilled to share that my dedicated efforts with the CDS Hooks Standard since 2017 have culminated in a truly significant milestone. I have been warmly welcomed to join the ranks of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 

Being part of a forward-thinking group dedicated to innovation and improvement is both exciting and an excellent opportunity to contribute significantly with my experience and commitment.

As we strive to move the standard forward, for those who are already using it, I encourage you to strengthen our community by adding your implementation here: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability.

Moreover, if you are contemplating its use or require assistance with implementation, know that my expertise as a freelance consultant is readily available. Let's harness the power of the CDS Hooks standard together as we build towards a future of remarkable digital healthcare solutions!

#CDSHooks #HealthcareInnovation #ProjectManagementCommittee #FreelanceConsultant
